BrochureContent.Content:
Welcome to 21A Glenamuck Cottages, a deceptively spacious 5-bedroom detached dormer family home enjoying generous and vibrant gardens of circa 0.4 acres, all located within the highly regarded and mature neighbourhood of Carrickmines, Dublin 18.

The accommodation is exceptionally versatile providing a sense of space that suits both family living and entertaining. The ground floor comprises a reception hall, setting the tone for the generous proportions found throughout the house. From here, there is a spacious living room, a double bedroom, a family bathroom, and a well-appointed kitchen & living room opening into a family dining room. Additional accommodation on this level includes a study a kitchenette, offering excellent flexibility for extended family or home-working needs. An inner hallway leads to two further double bedrooms, a shower room and a sunroom, creating a semi-independent living zone that can function as guest accommodation, or a potential rental unit if desired. This area can also be seamlessly reintegrated into the main house, depending on individual requirements. The first floor comprises a landing, two further double bedrooms, an additional shower room, and superb eave storage completing this floor.

Outside, the grounds are a standout feature and will undoubtedly be one of the home’s strongest draws. The property is approached over a generous driveway providing off-street parking, framed by mature and colourful planting that immediately conveys a sense of privacy and seclusion. Gated side access leads to the magnificent rear garden, extending to approximately 200 feet, and unfolds as a series of landscaped terraces. Here, paved patios sit alongside mature trees, vibrant planting, a vegetable patch, a pond and expansive lawns that offer superb space for outdoor living, recreation and entertaining.

Two large block-built storage sheds further enhance the outdoor offering and present excellent potential for a variety of uses, whether as a home gym, workshop, hobby room or simply valuable additional storage. This level of outdoor space and flexibility is increasingly rare in such a convenient and family friendly location.

The location is one of the property’s most compelling attributes. Carrickmines is renowned for its convenience and strong sense of community, with Carrickmines Retail Park and the vibrant villages of Kilternan, Stepaside and Foxrock all within easy reach, offering an excellent array of shopping, dining and everyday amenities. Leisure facilities in the vicinity include Dundrum Town Centre, Sandyford Business Park, Beacon South Quarter and Leopardstown Racecourse, as well as Westwood Gym, Carrickmines Lawn Tennis Club, numerous golf clubs and equestrian centres. The nearby Dublin and Wicklow Mountains provide exceptional opportunities for walking, cycling and outdoor pursuits.

The area is also well served by some of South County Dublin’s most highly regarded schools, including Our Lady of the Wayside, Gaelscoil Thaobh na Coille, Kilternan Church of Ireland National School, Stepaside Educate Together and Rosemont School. Transport links are excellent, with the Luas Green Line, Bus routes close at hand, while the M50 and N11 road networks ensure ease of access throughout Dublin and beyond.

21A Glenamuck Cottages represents a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial family home on an exceptional site in a prime South Dublin location. Offering generous and flexible accommodation, a magnificent rear garden and an enviable level of convenience, this outstanding property will appeal to discerning purchasers seeking a home of enduring quality and long-term appeal.
